{{Top|leg}}
'''Meril Power Station''' was located in [[Capital City (Omman)|Capital City]] on [[Omman Minor]]. It was connected to the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref> It was a secure facility controlled by the [[Black Bha'lir]], allowing them to land [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] with illegal cargo and keeping them safe from [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
